Spanish Documents: Authorities and Price Bands

Every document in Spain comes from a different office. This hub lists all six with the office that issues it and the observed band, so you can pick the right page before you open a chat.

Price bands differ by document by an order of magnitude and the checks differ completely. Read the office column before the price column, because the office tells you what the document is and the price only tells you what a seller hopes to get for it.

Spanish documents: the six offices

Issuing office by document.
DocumentOfficeObserved
Passportthe Policia Nacional170–620 EUR
Driving Licencethe Jefatura Provincial de Trafico110–450 EUR
ID Cardthe Policia Nacional80–290 EUR
Green Cardthe Oficina de Extranjeria310–1000 EUR
Visaa Spanish consulate140–510 EUR
Residence Permitthe Oficina de Extranjeria300–880 EUR

Two checks specific to Spain

  • Confirm the DNI or passport number passes the Spanish check letter calculation for the letter printed.
  • Check the licence for the EU category grid and the DGT hologram.

Local red flag

  • A DNI where the control letter does not match the number.
